column1: # Every migration in supabase/migrations, and what self-host does about it.
# The hosted migrations cannot run on self-host as written: they depend on
# pg_net and Vault, and some hard-code the hosted project's URL. Self-host
# instead keeps its own numbered migrations in ./migrations, ported by hand,
# and this file is the ledger that keeps the two in step.
# self-host/tests/manifest.test.ts fails when a migration exists upstream that
# is not listed here, so a schema change can no longer reach the server
# without someone deciding what it means for self-host.
#   ported   everything relevant to the MCP server is in the listed self-host migration(s)
#   partial  the listed self-host migration(s) carry the server-facing part; detail says what is left out
#   skipped  nothing the self-host MCP server reads or writes; detail says why
# The detail of ported/partial starts with the self-host migration number(s), e.g. "0003,0006: ...".
# When adding an upstream migration that touches a table, column, function or
# check the server uses: write the next self-host migration, list it here as
